status.field_tooltip: Field shown. You can also click another field on the map.
status.period_tooltip: How many days back to show. Longer periods are in Trends.
status.info: Latest data: {date} · last {days} days · alerts for the next 7 days
status.example: Example data: the numbers are made up until the satellite sources are connected.
status.tile_tooltip: Click to see it in its section
status.fixed_tooltip: From a soil map: one value, it does not change day to day.
status.texture_hint.sand: Drains very fast and holds little water or nutrients: water and fertilise little and often.
status.texture_hint.loamy_sand: Drains fast and holds little water: water little and often.
status.texture_hint.sandy_loam: Good drainage, holds a moderate amount of water. Easy to work.
status.texture_hint.loam: Balanced: good drainage and good water retention. Suits most crops.
status.texture_hint.silt_loam: Holds water well and is fertile, but crusts after heavy rain.
status.texture_hint.clay_loam: Holds water and nutrients well; drains slowly, avoid working it wet.
status.texture_hint.sandy_clay_loam: Moderate drainage and retention; can compact.
status.texture_hint.clay: Holds a lot of water, drains slowly and compacts: watch for waterlogging.
status.texture_hint.other: See how it drains and holds water in the triangle.
status.alert.heavy_rain: {mm} mm of rain in one day: check young plants for soil erosion.
status.alert.radiation: Strong sun ({value} MJ/m²): water early in the morning or at dusk.
status.alert.rain_tomorrow: Tomorrow about {mm} mm of rain: delay irrigation and fertiliser.
status.alert.frost_upcoming: Possible frost in {day} days ({temp} °C): protect sensitive plants.
status.alert.ndvi_drop: NDVI dropped {pct}% since the last image: check for water stress or pests.
status.alert.dry_soil: Soil moisture is low ({value}%): the crop may need water.
status.alert.low_nitrogen: Low nitrogen ({value} g/kg) for most crops.
analysis.placeholder_note: For now the analyses use example data: the numbers are not real yet.
analysis.example_tooltip: Placeholder: these numbers are made up until the real algorithms and data are connected.
analysis.var.suitability: Temperature suitability of the season-1 crop
analysis.vegetation.title: Vegetation productivity
analysis.vegetation.description: How much biomass the field produced month by month (FAO WaPOR, 300 m) and which zones are weaker.
analysis.vegetation.summary: The field produced on average {mean} gC/m² of biomass per month over the last year. On the map, weaker zones are brown.
analysis.vegetation.r.zones: The weakest zone produced {value} % compared with the field's average: visit it and look for pests, waterlogging or compaction.
analysis.vegetation.r.soil_test: Take soil samples from a weak and a strong zone to compare nutrients.
analysis.vegetation.r.cover: Consider a cover crop after harvest to protect the soil.
analysis.vegetation.r.decline: Vigour fell {change} % from last year: review fertilisation and irrigation.
analysis.frost.title: Frost risk
analysis.frost.description: The coldest temperature of each month (NASA POWER) spread over the field's relief, frost days and the frosts forecast for this week.
analysis.frost.summary: {days} frost days in the last year; {month} was the coldest month.
analysis.frost.m.days: Frost days in the last year
analysis.frost.m.min: Lowest temperature in the last year
analysis.frost.r.sensitive: Keep fruit trees and vegetables from flowering in the coldest months.
analysis.frost.r.protection: Plan frost protection (anti-frost irrigation, covers) for cold nights.
analysis.water.title: Water balance
analysis.water.description: Monthly rain (NASA POWER) minus the water the field actually used (evapotranspiration, FAO WaPOR, 300 m).
analysis.water.summary: In the last year the field used about {mm} mm more water than it rained, over {months} months.
analysis.water.m.deficit: Water deficit in the last year
analysis.water.r.irrigation: Plan about {mm} mm of irrigation for the dry season.
analysis.water.r.crops: Prefer drought-tolerant crops or varieties for the dry season.
analysis.water.r.mulch: Use mulch or no-till to keep soil moisture.
analysis.heat.title: Heat stress
analysis.heat.description: The hottest temperature of each month (NASA POWER) over the field's relief, and the days above the crop's limit (FAO EcoCrop).
analysis.heat.summary: {days} days in the last year reached {threshold} °C or more.
analysis.heat.m.days: Hot days in the last year
analysis.heat.m.max: Highest temperature in the last year
analysis.heat.r.flowering: Avoid flowering in {month}: plan sowing so it happens before or after.
analysis.heat.r.irrigation_time: Irrigate early in the morning on hot days.
analysis.rotation.title: Crop rotation
analysis.rotation.description: Compares rotation strategies (the current crop, a diversified rotation and a soil-building one) for this field's climate, pH and soil, with the crops' FAO EcoCrop requirements.
analysis.rotation.summary: Start with {first}; the diversified plan suits this field at {score} %.
analysis.rotation.r.avoid: Do not grow {crop} season after season: rotating breaks pest cycles and rests the soil.
fields.crop_placeholder: Type a crop: common or scientific name (e.g. peach, Prunus persica)
fields.crop_error: Choose a crop and variety from the list (required).
fields.data_missing_hint: The data source did not answer or has no data here. Type the value if you know it.
fields.data_status_loading: Loading zone data ({done}/{total})… Save is enabled when it finishes.
fields.data_status_partial: Some sources failed ({names}); their values are marked “not available”.
map.basemap_tooltip: Background: satellite image or street map
hover.hint: Double-click to check it · right-click for more
weather.title: Weather in this zone
fields.crop_info_missing: No information for this crop in FAO EcoCrop (or no connection).
analysis.texture.title: Soil texture
analysis.texture.description: Where the field's soil falls on the USDA texture triangle (clay, sand, silt) and what it means for water and management.
analysis.texture.summary: The topsoil (0-30 cm) is {texture}: {clay} clay, {sand} sand and {silt} silt.
analysis.texture.summary_unknown: The field has no texture data yet.
analysis.texture.rec.unknown: Edit the field to load (or type) its clay, sand and silt.
analysis.texture.rec.sandy.0: Sandy soils hold little water: irrigate little and often.
analysis.texture.rec.sandy.1: Add organic matter (compost, cover crops) to hold water and nutrients.
analysis.texture.rec.sandy.2: Split fertiliser doses: nutrients wash out quickly.
analysis.texture.rec.loamy.0: A balanced texture: good water holding and drainage for most crops.
analysis.texture.rec.loamy.1: Keep it covered between crops to protect its structure.
analysis.texture.rec.loamy.2: Avoid working it when wet, which compacts it.
analysis.texture.rec.silty.0: Silty soils crust easily: keep residues or a cover on the surface.
analysis.texture.rec.silty.1: They erode on slopes: plant across the slope or keep grass strips.
analysis.texture.rec.silty.2: They hold water well; irrigate less often than sandy soils.
analysis.texture.rec.clayey.0: Clay soils drain slowly: check drainage and avoid waterlogging.
analysis.texture.rec.clayey.1: Do not work them wet; deep-rooting crops help loosen them.
analysis.texture.rec.clayey.2: They hold many nutrients; adjust fertiliser to a soil test.
analysis.crop_growth.title: Crop growth simulation
analysis.crop_growth.description: Simulates the season of the field's crop with WOFOST (PCSE): its soil, the weather so far, the forecast and the zone's climate for the rest.
analysis.crop_growth.summary_no_crop: The field has no crop: choose one when editing the field.
analysis.crop_growth.summary_no_model: WOFOST has no model for this crop (it simulates annual field crops: cereals, legumes, potato, beet, oilseeds...).
analysis.crop_growth.summary_no_pcse: The crop model (PCSE) is not installed.
analysis.crop_growth.summary_in_season: Current season of {crop} ({variety}), sown on {sowing}, {mode}: expected yield {yield} t/ha of dry product.
analysis.crop_growth.summary_next: Next season of {crop} ({variety}), sowing on {sowing}, {mode}: expected yield {yield} t/ha of dry product.
analysis.crop_growth.rec.no_crop: Edit the field and choose its crop.
analysis.crop_growth.rec.no_model: Use the other analyses (frost, water, heat) for this crop.
analysis.crop_growth.rec.no_pcse: Install it with “make env-data” or “pip install pcse”.
analysis.crop_growth.rec.failed: Check the internet connection and try again.
analysis.crop_growth.rec.water_gap: Water shortage costs about {gap} of the yield: with irrigation it could reach {potential} t/ha.
analysis.crop_growth.rec.proxy: There is no model for this crop: the {model} model was used as the closest one.
analysis.crop_growth.rec.climate: {share} of the season uses last year's weather (beyond the forecast): read it as a likely scenario.
analysis.crop_growth.rec.local_review: The crop parameters are generic varieties: check dates and yields with local experience.
fields.data_status_loading_edit: Loading zone data ({done}/{total})… You can save now: data not loaded yet stays as it is.
fields.data_reload_failed: Could not download it again ({error}); the value was kept.
analysis.var.crop_limits: Crop temperature, rain, pH and soil limits
analysis.vegetation.m.annual: Dry biomass in the last year (approx.)
analysis.frost.m.forecast: Frosts forecast in the next 7 days
analysis.frost.m.typical: Frost days in a typical year (2001-2025)
analysis.frost.r.coming: Frost forecast on {days} of the next 7 days: protect sensitive crops now.
analysis.water.r.irrigated: The irrigation supplied about {mm} mm beyond the rain in the last year: plan at least that much water.
analysis.heat.r.choose_crop: Choose the field's crop to count the days above that crop's own limit.
analysis.rotation.r.data: Scores use generic crop limits (EcoCrop) and climate normals: check them with local experience and market prices.
analysis.common.summary_unavailable: The data for this analysis could not be obtained: {error}
analysis.common.r.retry: Check the internet connection and run the analysis again.
analysis.rotation.r.rainfed: The zone gets only about {mm} mm of rain a year: scores assume no irrigation. If the field is irrigated, mark it in “Edit field” for scores with irrigation.
analysis.frost.r.no_frost: There was no frost in the last year: frost does not limit sowing dates here, but check the forecast in winter.
